name: Obsidian Notes
description: Gives the agents an Obsidian vault as their durable knowledge base and is the authoritative catalog for note structure (templates, frontmatter, wikilinks, and update discipline), with TPM-only writes and a host-side Detect Vault button for setting the vault location.

vaultPath.label: Vault Path
vaultPath.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault root. Set it explicitly, OR use the Detect Vault button in this panel to auto-fill it by scanning for a directory containing a .obsidian marker. When set, it is used verbatim for the session. Leave blank to disable Obsidian notes.

writeFrontmatter.label: Write Frontmatter
writeFrontmatter.description: When on, every notes file this module writes opens with a YAML frontmatter block (title, type, created, updated, tags, plus per-type fields) as defined in the module's frontmatter schema. Turn off to write the section skeletons without any frontmatter block; all other structure conventions still apply.
